utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check the repair drive and see what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks. Let me know what you find, and I’ll help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll take a look and tell you the main issue.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we should nail down the plan early—who’s handling what, when, and where the donations go. Once we have the first version set, we can adjust if needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not agreeing to a plan until we’ve got the details in writing. Who exactly is handling the donations, and what source are we using for the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s fair—I’d like it written down too. Let’s list the donation handler and use the posted schedule from the drive sheet so we’re working from one version.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit behind, so could you remind me what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I think we still need to sort the drop-off list and check who’s bringing the tools. I may be mixing it up a bit, so if you just told me the latest, I’ll follow that.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll send the latest drop-off list and tool sign-up now, then we can fill any gaps after.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m hearing the repair drive is getting organized, and I’m ready to help spread the word. Let’s keep the plan simple and get everyone pointed in the same direction.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I’ve been hearing little bits too — sounds like folks just need a clear place to drop off tools and sign up. I’ll keep my ears open and pass along anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’s the plan I’m hearing too: one clear drop-off spot, one sign-up list, and I’ll keep repeating it until everybody’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, right — the repair drive. Catch me up on what’s needed and when you’re thinking of doing it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can help with the usual fixes—patching, tightening, and small repairs. I’m loose on timing, but I can swing by this weekend and we’ll figure out the rest.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That works for me — weekend’s good. Just send me the rough time and I’ll piece together the rest when I’m off.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple: let’s set a clear plan for the repair drive and stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll get the word out and keep it simple: clear plan, clear roles, and one place for updates. Let’s make this repair drive easy to join and impossible to miss.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me. Let’s keep the plan fixed and use one update place so everyone knows what to do.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need specifics: can you handle donations, pickup, or sorting? Pick one and tell me when you can do it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m in for the repair drive — feels like the kind of thing that brings everyone together. If you want, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be wonderful, Jules — the more neighbors who hear about it, the better. I’ll make sure the details are precise and easy to pass along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — send me the details, and I’ll share them around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m glad we’re finally talking about the repair drive — let’s keep the original plan clear and make sure we follow through on what we promised.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the original plan front and center and make sure everyone’s aligned on the follow-through.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Good — let’s stick to the plan, keep everyone informed, and see this through together.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll jot down the repair drive details first so I don’t miss anything. What supplies or commitments are we already set on?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just the basics so far—I'm good to help with the drive itself, but I haven't locked in any supplies or commitments yet. If you want, I can stick to the pickup and drop-off parts.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s helpful, Bo—I’ll note you for pickup and drop-off only for now. We can add supplies later once we’ve confirmed them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout—people are really pitching in already. I’m not sure on all the details yet, but it sounds like it’s off to a solid start.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, sounds like people are showing up. I haven’t heard the full plan yet, but I’m glad it’s moving along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Me too—if I hear the schedule or what they still need, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I’m tied up around school pickup right now—can we keep the repair drive plan quick and focused?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — let’s keep it tight. What are the key repair items, and what do you need from me right now?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the gist of the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly a neighborhood fix-it push — folks are bringing in broken stuff, swapping parts, and helping each other get things working again.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, that sounds right up my lane. What’s the main thing they need help with?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, the repair drive sounds like a good move — if that’s the plan everyone’s leaning toward, I’m in. I can help spread the word and keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, Vik — that’s exactly the kind of help we need. I’ll keep the plan tight and send you the details so you can help it spread.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — send me the details and I’ll keep repeating the same plan to everyone I run into.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh — right, the repair drive. I haven’t checked for any updates yet, but I can take a look and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks. Just tell me what’s left when you know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll check and only report back once I know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m in for the repair drive, Gus—just tell me what part you want me to handle.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Rey — could you handle the sorting and tool check? I’ll keep an eye on the actual repairs and we’ll wing the timing a bit.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yep, I can do that — I’ll sort the parts and check the tools now, and I’ll keep it quiet unless I find something off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Just checking we’re still on for the repair drive plan, Opal—if anything changed, I can update the group chat right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re still on for the repair drive plan, Rosa—no changes from my side. Go ahead and keep the group chat updated.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you—I’ll post that we’re still on and keep everyone posted if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we should get the repair drive details locked in early—who’s bringing what, and when. I’d feel better if we had a clear plan before anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll get the invite out today with a clear bring-list and timeline so everyone’s on the same page. Let’s lock it in early and keep it moving!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good to me—if you send the invite today, I’ll go by that first version and keep my part simple. Just make sure the bring-list and timeline are written down clearly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we have something solid on the repair drive, or is this still just rumor? If you’ve got a source, send it over and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t have anything solid yet, so I’m treating it as rumor for now. If I find a confirmed source, I’ll send it right over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — keep it as rumor until we’ve got a confirmed source. If anything turns up, send me the document or link and I’ll review it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple—if we make a plan for the repair drive, I’d rather stick to it. Tell me the time and place, and I’ll follow through.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Alright, just send me the time and place when you’ve got it, and I’ll work around my shift. I may be late, but I’ll catch up and follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. I’ll set the time and place and send it over, then we can stick to that plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces from the neighbors, but I’m happy to help if there’s anything I can do for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thank you, Nell. I’ll jot you down for help and let you know the first task as soon as I’ve sorted the list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. Just let me know where you need me first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m happy to help, though I may be mixing up the details a bit; what did you want me to bring again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: You said you'd bring the drill and a box of screws, Oren. If you can, the tape measure would help too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course — the drill, a box of screws, and the tape measure too. I’ll bring those along, unless I’m forgetting something again!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep it around school pickup times. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just need a firm time window when you’re free. I’ll keep it tight around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m free from 3:15 to 4:00, right after pickup. That should give you a tight window to work with.
